journeys.name: Full submit-form-and-create-account (seed-driven with cleanup)
preconditions: Dev stack running (bun dev)
A branch hierarchy node exists in the test tenant
e2e/helpers/seed-data.ts provides cleanupTestUser(email) — to be created in EXECUTE phase

steps: Admin logs in → navigate to /dashboard/branch/view → click first table row → land on /dashboard/branch/<nodeId>
Wait for modal → extract URL from [data-testid='invite-url-input'] value
Open fresh browser context (incognito) → navigate to extracted URL
Assert [data-testid='onboarding-branch-name'] shows branch name (non-empty, not placeholder)
Cleanup: call test-only cleanup endpoint or bun script to delete created user
assertions: Branch name on onboarding page is non-empty and matches the branch navigated to in step 1
After submit, page URL contains /dashboard
Network request POST /rpc/onboarding/redeemInvite returns 2xx
No JS errors in browser console during submit

areas.name: Commission Rule (Phase 1)
areas.existingCoverage: fixes-verification.spec.ts has appointment load test; does NOT test commission splits

journeys.name: Trainer cancels appointment → admin sees pending split with earnReason=cancellation
preconditions: At least one appointment in 'confirmed' status exists in test tenant
Seed helper: seedAppointment({ trainerId, customerId, serviceId, status: 'confirmed' }) — to be created in EXECUTE phase
Admin has appointment management permission
steps: Locate the seeded appointment row in the calendar or list view
Click the appointment → appointment detail panel opens
Assert confirm dialog appears with commission policy text
Switch to 'All Commissions' tab if not default
Filter or search for the trainer's name
assertions: Commission split row is visible for the trainer with earnReason badge showing 'Cancellation'
Row status badge shows 'Pending'
Split amount is greater than 0
No duplicate split rows for the same appointment

journeys.name: Trainer completes appointment → split appears with earnReason=completion
preconditions: Seeded appointment in 'confirmed' status
Seed helper: seedAppointment()
steps: Locate the split row for this appointment
assertions: Commission split row is visible with earnReason badge showing 'Completion'
Row status is 'Pending'
Amount > 0

journeys.name: POS sale of a service → NO commission split appears immediately
preconditions: At least one bookable service and one role=client member in test tenant
No pre-existing commission splits for the test member in this period (or use fresh member)
steps: Step 1 (Member): search and select a role=client member via [data-testid='pos-member-search-input']
Step 2 (Items): add a bookable service item via catalog
Note sale ID from success screen
Filter by trainer assigned to the service
assertions: No commission split row exists with salesOrderId matching the new sale
Commission split count for the trainer has NOT increased after the POS sale
No POST /rpc/commissions/* request fired during the POS flow

journeys.name: POS sale of a product → split appears immediately (not deferred)
preconditions: At least one non-bookable product with a commission rule configured
A role=client member in test tenant
steps: Add a product item (not a service) to the cart
assertions: Commission split row IS visible for the product sale
earnReason badge shows 'Sale' or immediate-earn label (not 'Cancellation' / 'Completion')
Status is 'Pending'

journeys.name: Payouts page mounts with real KPI strip (not stub)

[data-testid='payouts-kpi-approved'] shows a number >= 0
[data-testid='payouts-kpi-paid'] shows a number >= 0

Page title 'Payouts' is in the DOM

journeys.name: Run Batch drawer opens and preview fires on field change

journeys.name: Confirm payout creates a row in the payouts table

Date range encompasses the split's earnedAt

[data-testid='payouts-table'] tbody tr count increased by >= 1
The new row shows today's date in the Paid At column
The split that was 'approved' is now shown as 'paid' in /dashboard/commissions/view

areas.name: Package-Instance Lifecycle (Phase 5)
areas.notes: packages/instances/view now redirects to packages/view?tab=session-packs via makeTabRedirect. All journeys target the canonical URL.

journeys.name: Cancel package instance → row moves to Cancelled tab
preconditions: At least one package_instances row in 'active' status in test tenant
Admin has package_management permission
steps: Wait for [data-testid='instances-table'] to render with rows
Click [data-testid='instance-action-menu'] on the first active row
Assert the row is no longer in the active tab
Assert the row appears in the Cancelled tab
assertions: Cancel dialog opens after clicking action menu item
After confirmation, success toast appears
Row disappears from active list
Row appears in Cancelled filter list with status badge 'Cancelled'

journeys.name: Freeze package instance → moves to Frozen tab → Unfreeze restores to Active
preconditions: Active package instance in test tenant
Admin has package_management permission
steps: Optionally fill [data-testid='freeze-until-input'] with a future date
assertions: After freeze: row appears in Frozen filter, not in Active
After unfreeze: row returns to Active filter, disappears from Frozen
Status badge transitions: Active → Frozen → Active

journeys.name: Extend package instance expiry date by 30 days
preconditions: Active package instance with a known expiresAt date
Admin has package_management permission
steps: Note the expiry date from [data-testid='instance-expires-at'] on first active row
assertions: After extension, expiry date shown in the row is 30 days later than original
Toast shows success message
No error state in the dialog

journeys.name: Cancelled Sales view lists rows (no longer a redirect stub)

journeys.name: Receipt fallback shows 'Receipt unavailable' not a fake receipt

journeys.name: Installment plan POS path creates correct schedule (no drift)
preconditions: An installment plan configured in Settings with >= 2 installments
A role=client member in test tenant
steps: Select a service package supporting installment payment
Navigate to the Installments tab in /dashboard/packages/view?tab=installments
Locate the newly created installments for this sale
assertions: Number of installment rows matches the plan's numInstallments (exactly — not N-1 or N+1)
Due dates follow the plan's schedule (first due = sale date; subsequent = monthly cadence)
Each installment's salesOrderId is populated (Phase 7.3 fix)
No schedule drift: if plan says 6 installments, exactly 6 rows exist
